CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.com_autorizadores_inventario()
 RETURNS TABLE(username text, nombre text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select u.username::text, u.nombre::text
    from public.usuarios u
   where coalesce(u.activo, true)
     and (u.rol in ('admin', 'ceo') or (u.rol = 'proveedor' and u.supplier_key = 'comercializadora'))
     and (public.es_equipo_interno() or (public.es_proveedor() and public.mi_supplier_key() = 'comercializadora'))
   order by u.nombre;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.com_invocar(fn text, body jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select net.http_post(
    url := (select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'project_url') || '/functions/v1/' || fn,
    headers := pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('Content-Type', 'application/json',
      'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || (select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'anon_key')),
    body := body,
    timeout_milliseconds := 120000);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_user_with_password(p_username text, p_password text, p_nombre text, p_correo text, p_telefono text, p_rol text, p_supplier_key text, p_subtipo text, p_puede_ver_avance boolean, p_debe_cambiar boolean, p_permisos jsonb)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_new usuarios%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO usuarios (username, password, nombre, correo, telefono, rol,
    supplier_key, subtipo, puede_ver_avance, activo, debe_cambiar_pass, permisos)
  VALUES (lower(trim(p_username)), crypt(p_password, gen_salt('bf', 12)),
    p_nombre, p_correo, p_telefono, p_rol, p_supplier_key, p_subtipo,
    p_puede_ver_avance, true, p_debe_cambiar, p_permisos)
  RETURNING * INTO v_new;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'id', v_new.id, 'username', v_new.username, 'nombre', v_new.nombre,
    'rol', v_new.rol, 'activo', v_new.activo, 'subtipo', v_new.subtipo,
    'supplier_key', v_new.supplier_key, 'correo', v_new.correo,
    'telefono', v_new.telefono, 'permisos', v_new.permisos,
    'debe_cambiar_pass', v_new.debe_cambiar_pass
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.diagnostico_acl_crudo(p_tabla text)
 RETURNS TABLE(grantee text, privilege_type text, grantor text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) end as grantee,
    a.privilege_type,
    pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) as grantor
  from pg_class c
  cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl, acldefault('r', c.relowner))) a
  where c.relname = p_tabla
    and c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
  order by grantee, privilege_type;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.diagnostico_rls_detalle(p_tabla text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(tabla text, politica text, permissive text, comando text, roles text, condicion_using text, condicion_check text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    c.relname::text as tabla,
    pol.polname::text as politica,
    case when pol.polpermissive then 'PERMISSIVE' else 'RESTRICTIVE' end as permissive,
    case pol.polcmd
      when 'r' then 'SELECT' when 'a' then 'INSERT' when 'w' then 'UPDATE'
      when 'd' then 'DELETE' when '*' then 'ALL' else pol.polcmd::text
    end as comando,
    (select string_agg(rolname, ', ') from pg_roles where oid = any(pol.polroles)) as roles,
    pg_get_expr(pol.polqual, pol.polrelid) as condicion_using,
    pg_get_expr(pol.polwithcheck, pol.polrelid) as condicion_check
  from pg_policy pol
  join pg_class c on c.oid = pol.polrelid
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname = 'public'
    and (p_tabla is null or c.relname = p_tabla)
  order by c.relname, pol.polname;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.diagnostico_rls_tablas()
 RETURNS TABLE(tabla text, rls_habilitado boolean, num_politicas bigint, politicas_permissive bigint, politicas_restrictive bigint, tiene_deny_anon boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    c.relname::text as tabla,
    c.relrowsecurity as rls_habilitado,
    coalesce(p.total, 0) as num_politicas,
    coalesce(p.permissive, 0) as politicas_permissive,
    coalesce(p.restrictive, 0) as politicas_restrictive,
    coalesce(p.tiene_deny_anon, false) as tiene_deny_anon
  from pg_class c
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  left join (
    select
      pol.polrelid,
      count(*) as total,
      count(*) filter (where pol.polpermissive) as permissive,
      count(*) filter (where not pol.polpermissive) as restrictive,
      bool_or(pol.polname ilike '%deny%anon%' or pol.polname ilike '%anon%deny%') as tiene_deny_anon
    from pg_policy pol
    group by pol.polrelid
  ) p on p.polrelid = c.oid
  where n.nspname = 'public'
    and c.relkind = 'r'  -- solo tablas reales, no vistas
  order by c.relrowsecurity asc, num_politicas asc, c.relname asc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vincular_pedido_apertura()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Solo actuar si el pedido no tiene apertura vinculada
  IF NEW.apertura_id IS NULL OR NEW.apertura_id = '000' THEN
    
    -- Método 1: shopify_store_id (máxima confianza)
    IF NEW.shopify_store_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT id INTO NEW.apertura_id
      FROM aperturas
      WHERE shopify_store_id = NEW.shopify_store_id
        AND estatus NOT IN ('cancelada', 'cancelacion_pendiente')
      LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    -- Método 2: correo del franquiciatario (si método 1 no resolvió)
    IF (NEW.apertura_id IS NULL OR NEW.apertura_id = '000') 
       AND NEW.franquiciatario_email IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT a.id INTO NEW.apertura_id
      FROM aperturas a
      WHERE LOWER(a.correo_franq) = LOWER(NEW.franquiciatario_email)
        AND a.estatus NOT IN ('cancelada', 'cancelacion_pendiente')
      LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
